text:
Maria H.: Drafting an enterprise-facing one-pager + routing playbook for Private + Dedicated deployments. Need quick input on SLA language, benchmark narrative (latency/cost), webinar hooks, and inbound routing rules. Rough target to ship next Wed. Attaching draft in thread.

Samir (Product): +1. Suggest we lead with the predictable p99 latency story and fallback routing. Proposed line: "Predictable inference at scale with configurable SLAs and automated fallbacks." Can be tuned.

Alex G. (Growth): For inbound lead routing: funnel idea -> usage > 100k tokens/mo OR ask for dedicated capacity => AE. Compliance/regulatory flags => Solutions Eng. Everything else -> nurture.

Emma S. (Sales): Agreed. Add region + compliance filter (e.g., FedRAMP/HIPAA) to auto-route. Also include a 1-page qual checklist for AE calls.

Nick L. (Legal): Quick flag: wording can't promise "zero data retention". Use "configurable data retention & KMS/HSM integrations". Also avoid SLA numbers unless eng confirms.

Samir (Product): Good call. From infra side: p50 token-gen ~30–60ms on Dedicated with batching; hosted p95 for short prompts ~100–250ms. p99 varies by seq len & burst. Suggest we phrase as ranges and call out typical benchmark scenarios.

Maria H.: Webinar plan: 45-min session — 30-min demo + 15-min live Q&A. Panel: PM, Infra eng, Customer security lead. Promo blurb: "How to run LLMs at scale with predictable economics and enterprise controls." CTA: book a demo / request compliance checklist. Thoughts?

Alex G.: CTA funnel two-tiered: demo request -> Sales AE; technical deep-dive -> Solutions Eng. Landing page should ask for deployment mode, compliance needs, and desired SLA. Use those to route.

Emma S.: I'll draft the one-pager checklist (two-sided): 1) Data residency 2) SLA targets 3) Throughput & burst 4) Audit & logging 5) Integration timeline + contacts. Keep it digestible.

Maria H.: Draft routing pseudo-rules for playbook:
```
if (org_size >= 500 && wants_dedicated) -> sales.AE
else if (compliance_needs in [FedRAMP, HIPAA, PCI]) -> solutions_eng.team
else if (monthly_tokens > 100000) -> growth.lead
else -> nurture.marketing
```

Alex G.: Add follow-up triggers: post-webinar warm lead -> AE; trial with SI interest -> Solutions Eng. Also attach a lightweight scoring: usage + compliance + SLA urgency.

Nick L.: That routing works. Please include a short legal boilerplate: "Claims subject to capacity & contractual SLAs; specific latency guarantees available in dedicated contracts." I'll draft language for the bottom of the one-pager.

Maria H.: Timeline: first draft EOD tomorrow, internal review Thu, finalize Fri. @Samir (Product) please confirm acceptable p99 phrasing by Thu AM. @Nick L. please sign off on legal boilerplate by Thu EOD.

Samir (Product): On it — will check with infra and reply Thu AM.

Nick L.: Will review and iterate.

launch-bot: Reminder: Marketing asset review due in 48h :calendar_spiral:

Maria H.: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
